meta.note: Offline starting point, NOT quotes and NOT a yield. Every id, ticker and asset name here is a real CoinGecko-listed asset. Prices, market caps, volumes, percentage changes and ATH levels are approximate round figures for 2026-08-01, hand-set to be plainly reasonable rather than precise. Nothing on these rows pays anything: spot crypto has no yield, and the range shown in the app is computed from the volatility below by the same code that runs after a live refresh. Refresh to replace every figure with a measured one. The snapshotSeries array on each row is an illustrative shape, not a recorded price path: see fields.snapshotSeries.

fields.snapshotStats: BUNDLED-SNAPSHOT-ONLY field; the live API does not return it. volAnnualised is an approximate annualised volatility in percent and volRatio is the recent-vs-baseline volatility ratio. Live rows measure both from the 168-point hourly sparkline instead. A hand-authored price path is not a price history, so no statistic on these rows is derived from one: the snapshotSeries below is drawn, never measured, and the volatility stays an openly labelled estimate.
fields.high_24h: Set so that the Parkinson range estimator reproduces roughly the stated volatility, keeping the fallback path and the snapshot path consistent with each other.
fields.ath_change_percentage: Negative, as CoinGecko reports it: percent BELOW the all-time high.
fields.snapshotSeries: BUNDLED-SNAPSHOT-ONLY field; the live API does not return it. 60 evenly-spaced points across the same seven days the volatility describes: it ends at current_price, starts price_change_percentage_7d ago, its wiggle is scaled to volAnnualised, and it spans at least the 24h high-low range. It is an illustrative shape for the offline chart and NOT a recorded price path — nothing is measured from it, volatility still comes from snapshotStats, and every row still reports its volatility as a bundled approximation. Live, the chart comes from the real 168-point hourly sparkline, thinned the same way.
